name: Unhook Open-Source Webhook Development
free_limit: MIT-licensed open-source webhook testing and routing toolkit with CLI, editor integrations, replay, event inspection and a documented self-hosted Docker deployment; no software license fee.
watch_out: Self-hosted operation requires your own server, public URL, database/Redis and maintenance. Do not assume the hosted unhook.sh service or team cloud features have unlimited free usage; verify cloud limits separately.
